name: Disneyland Alien Pizza Planet "Alien Macarooooon" (Salted Caramel Buttercream — Seed-Free!)
whyItWorks: Unlike Jolly Holiday's coconut-shred Matterhorn Macaron or raspberry-seeded Rose Macaron, the cute green **Alien Macarooooon** at Pizza Planet is filled with smooth salted caramel buttercream and chocolate ganache—zero coconut shreds and zero berry seeds!
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mobile-order the Alien Macarooooon at Alien Pizza Planet and take a lactase tablet for the buttercream.
watchOuts: Shell is made with finely ground blanched almond flour—avoid if allergic to tree nuts
